notes.title: Gameplay Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Patch 1.1[/b]

Hello everyone,

It’s almost been a month since the launch of [i]The Rangers in the South[/i], and the support and feedback from the community have been incredibly valuable.

Based on this, I have gathered the best comments and suggestions to develop the first gameplay patch. This update addresses some "urgent" issues affecting the core game experience while also redefining some key mechanics.

[h1]What's New[/h1]

• [b]New Currency: Ranger Points[/b]
A new currency, "Ranger Points," has been added. These points can be used to purchase persistent upgrades, such as increased inventory space, permanent skill improvements, or starting with more rerolls.

• [b]New Death Menu[/b]
Upon death, a new menu will be displayed, showing various character statistics: number of enemies defeated, gold obtained, duration of the run, and more. Based on these attributes, a final score will be calculated, which will translate into a certain amount of Ranger Points usable for the next character.

• [b]Difficulty Menu[/b]
A new menu allows players to select difficulty levels when starting a new character. This system enables adjustments to hunger rate generation, potion disable options, and other factors. Increasing the difficulty will also boost the number of Ranger Points earned at the end of each run. To unlock new difficulty levels, players must defeat the Demon Lord.

• [b]Skill Enhancements[/b]
All skills can now be upgraded via a new initial menu. Enhancements vary for each skill, from reducing cooldowns to making certain abilities bounce between enemies.

• [b]Customization Options[/b]
A basic character customization option has been added.

I am very excited about this version as it addresses many of the most common and important player concerns.

I invite everyone to join our Discord: [url]https://discord.gg/gYZxQFpR9M[/url] to share suggestions for future gameplay patches and report any bugs.

[b]Don't forget to check the 2025 Roadmap![/b] The next update will feature the Necromancer class and new boss mechanics. See you in the game!

notes.title: 2025 ROADMAP
notes.notes:
[h1]The Future of [i]The Rangers in the South[/i] is in Your Hands! 🌟 Our 2025 Roadmap[/h1]

Dear Community,  
We are incredibly grateful for the support and enthusiasm you’ve shown for [i]The Rangers in the South[/i]. This journey is just beginning, and we want to share with you what’s coming next for the game.

[h2]🚀 ASAP: Upcoming Updates[/h2]
[b]Controller and Steam Deck Support:[/b]  
We’re working hard to make [i]The Rangers in the South[/i] fully compatible with Steam Deck and controllers, ensuring the game is as comfortable and accessible as possible for all players.

[b]Keybinding Configuration:[/b]  
We will introduce customizable keybinding options so you can adjust controls to fit your playstyle.

[h2]📅 First Quarter of 2025[/h2]
[b]Necromancer Class:[/b]  
Control hellish minions, explode corpses, and unlock a full set of dark abilities.

[b]Infernal Portals:[/b]  
A new exploration mechanic: face waves of enemies as you traverse infernal portals.

[b]More Dungeon Variations, Skills, and Mechanics:[/b]  
We’ll add improvements based on community feedback to enrich the gameplay experience.

[h2]📅 Second Quarter of 2025[/h2]
[b]Boss and Enemy Rework:[/b]  
New unique mechanics for bosses and a wider variety of enemies with distinct traits and abilities.

[b]Hunter Class:[/b]  
Set traps, control animals, use smoke bombs, and throw various objects to overcome challenges.

[b]New Dungeon Biome:[/b]  
Redesigned dungeons with unique traps and a completely new exploration experience.

[b]Skills and Mechanics Suggested by the Community[/b]

[h2]📅 Third Quarter of 2025[/h2]
[b]New Biome: Islands:[/b]  
Explore a brand-new setting full of challenges and mysteries.

[b]Monk Class:[/b]  
Master martial arts and use fists and speed-based attacks to defeat your enemies.

[b]Skills and Mechanics Suggested by the Community[/b]

[h2]📅 End of 2025[/h2]
[b]Surprises to be Announced![/b]  
We’re working on something very special to wrap up the year. Stay tuned for more details.

[h2]🙌 Thank You for Being Part of This Adventure[/h2]
Your support and feedback are essential for [i]The Rangers in the South[/i] to evolve and grow. This roadmap is just the beginning of what’s to come. We want you to know this is the [b]minimum[/b] amount of planned features! Don’t be surprised if we add even more (or release them earlier than expected).

🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3074110/The_Rangers_In_The_South/]Steam Store Link[/url]  

[b]See you in the southern lands![/b]

notes.title: Pre-release and Endgame Anouncement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are incredibly excited and proud to announce the official release of The Rangers in the South on Thursday, January 9th. Only one week left!

It has been a long journey filled with dedication and effort, and we can't wait for you to experience it.

In addition to confirming that the game will be available in multiple languages from day one, we want to share some details about the endgame mechanics we've been refining over the past few days.

As you may already know, the game features roguelike mechanics, meaning each run or character will develop a unique combat strategy based on a selection of abilities. This ensures that, eventually—through luck or strategy—you might defeat the final boss of the game.

If you reach this point, congratulations! But this is where the real challenge begins.

Once you defeat the final boss, a Final Boss Counter will unlock. However, with each victory, all enemies will gain 10% more health and damage, progressively increasing the difficulty.

All this data will be compiled into a global leaderboard, showcasing the players who have defeated the final boss the most times. The player holding the world record will have their name proudly displayed on the game's main menu. (The leaderboard will also be available in the Steam community.)

To help you overcome these escalating challenges, we've added additional mechanics to aid your progress—but we won't spoil everything just yet!

We can't wait to see who will claim the title of First World Champion.

Additionally, we have many ideas for introducing new mechanics, abilities, and content. We're always open to hearing community suggestions, so don't hesitate to reach out if you have any ideas.

We hope you enjoy it!

Best regards,The Rangers in the South Team

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It’s been over a month since we launched our demo, and we’ve received thousands of comments! Thank you so much for taking the time to try it out, share your feedback, and enjoy it!

Many of your comments have been extremely valuable, and we’ve been working hard to incorporate them into the game! For this reason, we want to let you know that we have updated our demo with a lot of the feedback we received from the community.

As you know, we are a really small team, so we haven’t been able to address all of your suggestions yet, but please know that we are taking them into account!

Remember, the game launches on January 9th, so we are still welcoming your feedback!

(You can now get the dog in the game)
Best regards to everyone,
Slat

notes.title: Successful First Beta Test Completed for Our Upcoming Game!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the successful completion of our first beta test for our upcoming game! This pivotal milestone was achieved with the incredible support and expertise of a renowned MMORPG guild that boasts over a decade of experience tackling the toughest challenges in the gaming world.

Their impressive background and dedication brought a wealth of knowledge and insight to our beta testing phase. Over the course of the test, they meticulously explored every aspect of the game, providing us with detailed feedback and constructive criticism.

The feedback we received has been invaluable. It has given us a clear path forward, allowing us to identify areas for improvement and polish the game's mechanics, visuals, and overall experience. We're committed to delivering a game that not only meets but exceeds player expectations.

This beta test marks a significant step in our journey, and we're incredibly grateful to the guild members for their time, effort, and passion. Their contributions have been crucial in shaping the future of our game.

We are now hard at work implementing the feedback and making the necessary adjustments. Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to refine and enhance the game. Exciting times are ahead, and we can't wait to share the final product with you all.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We look forward to embarking on this journey together!

You check our discord server for more info: 
https://discord.gg/vXsxYPrE

Best regards,

Slat,
DPA Studios
